title: Freya and the Oath
author: Casper Vane
blurb: Ansel Oyelaran, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
